name: agritrace-caliper
description: Hyperledger Caliper benchmark for AgriTrace-ID network

scripts.lint:workloads: node -c workloads/registerActor.js && node -c workloads/registerBatch.js && node -c workloads/queryActor.js && node -c workloads/issueCertificate.js && node -c workloads/recordCompliance.js && node -c workloads/issueLC.js && node -c workloads/settleLC.js && node -c workloads/workload.js
scripts.test: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/networkConfig.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/bench-config.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test
scripts.debug:register-actor: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/networkConfig.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/debug-register-actor.yaml --caliper-fabric-gateway-eventstrategy none --caliper-logging-level debug
scripts.benchmark: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/networkConfig.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/bench-config.yaml --caliper-fabric-gateway-eventstrategy none
scripts.benchmark:paper: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace ./ --caliper-networkconfig networks/networkConfig.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/bench-config-paper.yaml --caliper-fabric-gateway-eventstrategy none
